creator_price_unavailable: A new price cannot be entered until this currency has a configured sale rule.
author_erasure_action: Erase my posts in this thread…
author_erasure_scope: This erases only your posts and their revisions in this thread. Other people’s posts and your account are not deleted. Copies in inboxes or on external services are outside this action and may remain.
author_erasure_irreversible: Physical cleanup runs asynchronously. Erased content cannot be restored, including content already removed before an operation stops.
author_erasure_admission_unavailable: Erasure is currently unavailable: current permission to erase cannot be checked here.
author_erasure_confirmation: I understand that erasing my posts is permanent.
author_erasure_uncertain: The response was lost or could not be confirmed. Your request may have been accepted. Retry the same request to recover its operation without starting another.
author_erasure_forbidden: Your current permission does not allow this action. No completion can be confirmed here.
author_erasure_not_found: This operation or its source is no longer available to you. This does not confirm that erasure finished.
author_erasure_sign_in: Sign in again to check this operation with your own account.
author_erasure_conflict: This request conflicts with the current source. Return to the thread and review it before making another request.
author_erasure_unavailable: The erasure service is unavailable. Its current outcome could not be checked.
author_erasure_queued_copy: Your request was accepted and is waiting to start. The service has not reported progress yet; acceptance does not mean cleanup is complete.
author_erasure_running_copy: Cleanup is underway. The counts below show what the service has reported as processed so far. They do not show how much work remains.
author_erasure_success: The service confirmed that cleanup completed for your posts in this thread.
author_erasure_terminal_permission: Erasure stopped because current permission or account authorization no longer allows it. Review your access before requesting further cleanup.
author_erasure_terminal_changed: Erasure stopped because its source or required conditions changed. Return to the thread to review its current state.
author_erasure_terminal_dependency: The service could not finish this operation. Work already erased remains permanent. Check service availability before making a new request.
author_erasure_terminal_failed: The service reported that erasure failed. Work already erased remains permanent. Return to the thread to review its current state.
author_erasure_interface_count_details_c: These counts are reported by the service. They are not totals or estimates of the work left, and they do not confirm removal of copies outside this thread.
author_erasure_manual: Automatic checks have paused. Select Check again to ask for the latest available status.
author_erasure_bounded_refresh: This page will check a few more times while it is visible. After that, select Check again to ask for the latest status. You can leave and reopen this operation without restarting cleanup.
lifecycle_leave_unsaved: Your selected action, private reason and reviewed confirmation are kept only on this page. Leaving discards them.
lifecycle_intro: Review this account, choose an available action and check its consequences before confirming.
lifecycle_reason_help: Leave empty to omit the reason, or enter 1–2000 characters. Your exact text is sent privately with this request.
lifecycle_denied: Your current authority does not allow this request.
lifecycle_missing: This account cannot currently be found or viewed. Its current sign-in state is unknown.
lifecycle_unavailable: Account access and available actions could not be checked. Check availability before continuing.
lifecycle_pending: Related changes are still pending. Completion has not been confirmed.
lifecycle_conflict: This request was not applied because it conflicts with the account’s current state. Check availability and review your choice before trying again.
lifecycle_refused: This request was not applied. Review the action and reason before trying again.
lifecycle_recorded: Your request was recorded. This does not confirm the account’s current sign-in state or that related cleanup and other changes have finished.
lifecycle_uncertain: We couldn’t confirm whether this request was applied. Keep this page open to keep the operation. Check availability, then retry this same confirmed request when available. Do not start a replacement request.
lifecycle_locked: Your confirmed request is kept on this page. A new request is blocked while the original outcome or remaining effects are unresolved. Leaving or reloading loses this page’s copy.
lifecycle_state_unavailable: The account’s current sign-in state and progress of related changes cannot be checked here yet.
lifecycle_capability_unavailable: Suspension and reinstatement are not currently available to you for this account.
lifecycle_suspend_effect: Suspension blocks sign-in immediately. Related cleanup and other changes may continue afterward. Your reason stays private.
lifecycle_reinstate_effect: Reinstatement requires a fresh sign-in. Old sessions and tokens will not work again. Earlier related changes may still be pending. Your reason stays private.
lifecycle_operation_help: Retries keep the original immutable account, action, exact reason and idempotency key. They require a manual availability check and current authorization. Nothing is saved to browser storage or added to the URL; the request is kept only in this page’s memory.
lifecycle_protocol_help: Suspension advances the authentication floor and fence before Auth cleanup; operator effects can continue afterward. Reinstatement does not revive old sessions or tokens. A receipt records a command response, not a current lifecycle observation or completed effects. Effects are never retried automatically.
lifecycle_availability_help: Only exact native suspension or reinstatement advertisements enable these actions. Current scopes, consent and authority still apply and are checked before receipt access. The management read does not supply private lifecycle state or effect progress. A receipt, missing public identity, empty page or later denial cannot settle an earlier unknown operation.
library_follow_counts_description: Your following total is private. Follower counts are available only for resources you can manage.
library_follow_counts_denied: This count is not available with your current access.
library_follow_counts_unavailable: Private counts are unavailable. Try again later.
library_follow_counts_context_help: Open follower counts from a resource’s management menu to see its private total.
library_follow_counts_invalid_context: This resource context is invalid. Open the link again from the resource’s management menu.
library_follow_count_context_id_help: Enter the resource UUID. The type and ID identify a target only; native permissions still decide whether its follower count is shown.
settings_managed_unavailable: This account could not be checked. It may be unavailable or outside your current access. Try again.
settings_managed_read_only: Private, read-only account details for your current signed-in identity.
settings_managed_responsibilities_unavai: Responsibilities are unavailable or not granted for this account.
settings_managed_observation: These are current relationship observations. Neither a current relation nor a reconciling responsibility confirms that an account operation completed.
settings_managed_navigation_unavailable: Account management actions are unavailable from this view.
value_denied: You cannot read this value right now.
value_missing: This reading is unavailable or concealed.
value_error: The current reading could not be loaded. Try again.
value_basis: This is the value currently shown for this field. Accepting a proposal alone does not select it for this Context.
value_reference_unavailable: This reference has no readable parts.
value_citation_scope: A citation supports an assertion; it is not verification or a licence for text or images. Provider metadata and rights are explained in Sources.
value_accepted: Accepted; current selection is established separately by the reader above.
value_metadata_denied: You cannot read this review information right now.
value_not_returned: This statement’s review details were not returned on this page.
value_metadata_unavailable: Review information is unavailable; the current statement above remains the reading.
value_adoption_unavailable: No explicit adoption metadata was returned.
value_page_bound: The value above remains the current reading; this page does not include its review decision.
value_change_unavailable: A safe change explanation is unavailable. Changes lists only the metadata actually returned.
value_withheld: Reveal this spoiler on the subject page before reading it.
value_not_selected: This statement is not available as a selected value in the current reading. It may have changed or be concealed.
curation_basis: Draft based on head {head}. Edit a template, then publish the whole profile.
curation_editor_help: The editor’s Publish button submits all draft templates. Close the editor before switching templates; unpublished editor changes are discarded.
curation_add_help: Start from the generic page. Type keys use a CURIE such as schema:Book; routes use paths such as /books.
curation_added: Template added to the draft. Publish to activate it.
curation_invalid: This profile cannot be published. Your draft is preserved.
curation_stale: The active presentation changed. Your draft is preserved; review the current profile before choosing what to keep.
curation_forbidden: Your current permissions do not allow this operation. Your draft and original publication are preserved. Retry after access is restored.
curation_limited: Too many requests. Your draft and original publication are preserved. Retry later.
curation_unknown: The publication outcome is unknown. Retry the original publication to resolve it.
curation_unavailable: Presentation is unavailable. Your draft is preserved. Try again.
curation_partial: The profile was published, but activation is unconfirmed.
curation_published: Last publication confirmed at head {head}. Later draft edits remain unpublished.
curation_retained: The original publication is retained at expected head {head}. Retrying submits that exact profile; later draft edits stay in the editor.
curation_compare: Compare current draft and inspected saved profile
curation_review_help: Keep preserves your current draft and uses the inspected saved version for your next publication. Nothing is published now. Publishing later replaces the whole saved profile; it does not merge templates.
curation_discard: Discard current draft and load inspected profile
curation_reconcile: Keep current draft for next publication
curation_resolve_first: This read does not confirm the original publication. Resolve it before starting another publication.
curation_reconciled: Draft kept at the reviewed head. Review your edits, then publish a new intent.
curation_discarded: Draft discarded. The reviewed active profile is loaded.
character_intro: Describe an independently referable fictional character. Appearances and actor or voice credits belong to the exact work, with their native qualifiers.
character_work_help: Choose the actual work. Add its character appearance, actor or voice credit separately. Select the character qualifier for each credit; no credits are copied between works.
character_terms_help: Names and descriptions open the existing terms editor. If its native producer is unavailable, the draft remains pending. Original text uses the authored editor and an explicit licence.
character_create_correction_fallback: This error does not identify an editable field in the current form. Review the names and initial facts. Your draft is kept; the exact diagnostic is in Technical details.
character_create_help: Enter a name in its data language. Add only facts you know; initial facts are selected by native creation. Later corrections are proposals awaiting review.
character_initial_fact_withdrawn: The selected field is no longer offered for this character. Your entries are kept. Choose a current field, then add it.
character_created: Character created. Open the current reader or continue with corrections and work credits.
character_actor_gap: The current release has no separate actor-to-character credit property. Only emitted appearance and voice-credit fields are offered.
character_relationships_intro: Work appearances, appearance-specific age and role, and directed character relationships come from the current release. Facts on one work stay on that work. Voice credits are a separate list. Correction opens the existing relation editor for the selected statement and returns here.
character_relationships_profile_intro: Read appearances and directed relationships without mixing one work’s qualifiers into another. Correction uses the existing relation editor for the exact selected statement.
character_relationships_slice: This page is one native window of the selected association.
character_relationships_pending: Updates to these associations are still being prepared. Read again before treating them as current.
character_relationships_empty: No readable rows were returned on this page.
character_relationships_unresolved: This endpoint has no readable summary.
character_relationships_vanished: This endpoint is no longer readable. Its previous facts are not shown.
character_relationships_assertion_unavai: The statement’s full evidence was not returned. This row cannot be edited here.
character_relationships_age_unreleased: Age at a specific appearance is not admitted in the current release. It is not written as a timeless character fact.
character_relationships_main_unreleased: A dedicated related-character identity (main-character linkage) is not admitted in the current release. Appearance role remains the role qualifier on the work.
character_relationships_relation_unrelea: No directed character-to-character relationship property is admitted in the current release.
character_relationships_field_unreleased: This qualifier is not admitted on the holder’s current Type. It is shown as stored meaning and is not offered for correction here.
character_relationships_descriptor_unava: The holder Type descriptor is independently unreadable. Stored meaning is shown; correction admission waits for a current descriptor.
character_relationships_endpoint_unreada: This association could not be read ({stream}). Other groups are unchanged.
character_relationships_no_stream: No appearance, relationship or voice association is admitted for this character Type.
character_relationships_signed_out: Sign in to read current associations and open a correction.
exposure_intro: Review the public availability of installed platform capabilities. Public opening does not grant permission to perform protected operations.
exposure_partial_inventory: These are groups from your visible catalogue. Visibility and viewer admission do not establish current public status or a complete installed inventory.
exposure_current_unavailable: Current public exposure data is unavailable. Public status remains unknown until a current native management read is available.
exposure_actions_unavailable: Current configuration actions are unavailable. Only an exact current native open or close permission can enable a change.
exposure_no_visible_groups: No groups were returned in your visible catalogue. This does not mean that no groups are installed.
exposure_current_page: Current configuration from one native management page. More groups may be available through the continuation control.
exposure_signed_out: Sign in to review platform exposure.
exposure_denied: Access to this review was denied.
exposure_unavailable: The installed catalogue could not be loaded. Try reloading.
exposure_open_effect: Open {group} to public admission. Existing operation permissions still apply.
exposure_close_effect: Close {group} to public admission. Callers with the required platform gate grants may still use it.
exposure_keep_operation: The outcome is unknown. Keep this operation unchanged; retrying reuses its original group, action, body and idempotency key.
exposure_recorded: The native command outcome was recorded. It is historical and does not establish current public status. Reload current data before drawing conclusions.
exposure_uncertain: The command outcome is unknown. No further change will run automatically.
exposure_not_sent: The command was not sent because its current catalogue or exact permission could not be verified.
exposure_changed: The recorded command changed exposure at its execution time.
exposure_unchanged: The recorded command made no exposure change (changed: false). This is a successful historical outcome.
erasure_intro: Check what has finished and what still needs to happen after account deletion.
erasure_barrier_help: This is when deletion took effect, not when data removal finished.
erasure_retained_heading: Records kept under the retention policy
erasure_signed_out: Sign in again to see deletion progress. Signing in does not restart deletion.
erasure_denied: You do not currently have permission to see this account’s deletion progress. This does not tell us whether data removal has finished.
erasure_missing: No deletion progress is available for this account selection. This does not tell us whether the account exists or data removal has finished.
erasure_unavailable: We cannot check deletion progress right now. This does not mean deletion failed; whether data removal has finished is unknown. Try checking again.
erasure_retention: Removal finished; required records still kept
erasure_pending: Data removal is still in progress
erasure_retention_help: Routine data removal has finished, but some records must still be kept under the retention policy. Full erasure is not complete.
erasure_complete_help: The service reports that account data removal is complete. This status does not confirm deletion from external services or backups.
erasure_pending_help: Account deletion was accepted. Services are still removing data or confirming that removal has finished.
erasure_no_pending_names: No service names are listed as pending. This alone does not confirm that data removal has finished.
erasure_retained_yes: Some records must still be kept under the retention policy. This status does not provide their details or a date for their deletion.
erasure_retained_no: No records are reported as still needing retention. This alone does not confirm that data removal has finished.
erasure_late_yes: Some items found after deletion still need to be removed.
erasure_late_no: No later-found items are reported as awaiting removal. This alone does not confirm completion.
erasure_frontier_yes: Some service work started before deletion still needs to finish or be confirmed.
erasure_frontier_no: No earlier service work is reported as pending. This alone does not confirm completion.

work_parts_no_stream: No part relation is available for this type.
work_parts_slice: These are the relations returned on this page, in the order received. This may be only part of the composition.
work_parts_pending: Updates to these relations are still being prepared. Read again before treating them as current selected relations.
work_parts_order_readonly: Position cannot be edited for this relation. Existing qualifiers are preserved; the order shown cannot be changed here.
work_parts_empty: No readable parts were returned on this page.
work_parts_unresolved: The target has no readable summary.
work_parts_assertion_unavailable: The relation’s full evidence was not returned. This row cannot be edited here.
work_parts_add: Propose containment with an existing part
work_parts_draft_discard_confirmation: Discard only this unsent relation draft and its local edits and citation? Published relations will not change.
work_parts_draft_discard_locked: This draft has a submitted or unresolved relation command. Keep it open to retain its exact command and review state.
work_parts_not_admitted: The current holder Type does not admit this relation. The draft is retained.
work_parts_order_intro: Each changed membership is an independent native proposal. This is not an atomic save, rollback, or publication.
work_parts_order_partial: This review covers the memberships loaded on this page. It is not a complete series order.
work_parts_order_limit: At most {count} readable memberships from this page can be staged.
work_parts_order_forward: This membership is recorded on the container.
work_parts_order_inverse: This membership is recorded on the member.
work_parts_order_slot_new: The position is this relation’s slot key. The proposal addresses a new slot. The original slot stays until an independent native action.
work_parts_order_slot_same: The proposal replaces only the position qualifier on the original slot. Other qualifiers, citations, rank and source meaning stay.
work_parts_order_review_intro: These are the exact changed memberships. Each one is proposed independently and may return a different result.
work_parts_order_stale: These drafts changed after this review. Review the current included changes before submitting.
work_parts_order_submit: Submit included position changes / retry unresolved
work_parts_order_none: No included position changes to review.
work_parts_order_disabled_definition: The current definitions no longer admit an editable position. The private draft is retained.
work_parts_order_disabled_holder: This holder cannot be edited from the current page. The private draft is retained.
work_parts_order_absent: Not present on the current page after the latest read
work_parts_order_discard_confirm: Discard only unsent local position corrections on this page? Unresolved native commands are kept.
work_parts_order_retained: Unresolved position commands from this page are retained. A current read is required before editing other memberships.
work_parts_create_episode: Create an episode of this series

work_parts_created_child_on_page: The created episode is on this page of the current parts stream.
work_parts_created_child_located: The created episode is not on this page of the current parts stream. This is its current identity; later pages are not scanned.

managed_actions_unavailable: This management action is currently unavailable.

game_profile_grain: Choose the actual work, independently referable add-on or software release. Platforms and languages never create releases automatically.

game_profile_support: Only fields in the current emitted Type are offered. Software releases are separate subjects. A missing field is unsupported here.

library_publication_confirm_one: I confirm publication of exactly {count} selected item.
library_publication_confirm_empty: I deliberately want to publish an empty selection (0 items). This replaces any current public selection with an empty one.
library_publication_privacy: Private criteria and reading facts stay private. Publication creates no access grant, paid entitlement or source URL. The public viewer still checks disclosure for each subject.
library_publication_stale: The Collection or source changed. Reload manually and choose again before publishing.
library_publication_denied: Publication was refused. Reload to check current access before choosing again.
library_publication_unknown: The result is unknown. Keep this page open and retry the same request; its selection and key are unchanged.

library_publication_complete: Published {count} selected items. The public view decides which subjects are currently disclosed.
library_publication_complete_one: Published {count} selected item. The public view decides which subjects are currently disclosed.
library_publication_published_unavailabl: Previously published membership is unavailable. That does not mean the Collection has zero public members.
library_publication_meaning_unavailable: Immutable accepted meaning is not present on this Collection representation.

presentation_preview_precedence: The native resolver chooses the route, then type, then nearest structural base, then generic template.
presentation_preview_address_help: Enter an existing subject UUID, or an exact route configured in the active profile, such as /.
presentation_preview_realm_help: Leave empty for Global. A Realm uses its current anonymous Context and publication rules; unavailable access never becomes a Global preview.
presentation_preview_invalid: Enter a valid subject UUID or supported route. A Realm ID must also be a UUID.
presentation_preview_denied: This target cannot be read anonymously with current permissions.
presentation_preview_missing: No anonymous page is available at this target. It may be missing, private or removed, or the route may not be configured.
presentation_preview_unavailable: The current public page or its matching profile is unavailable. Retry the inspection.
presentation_preview_changed: The active profile changed during inspection. Inspect again to read its current page.
presentation_preview_redirect: This subject has a canonical account page. Open its public address to inspect it.
presentation_preview_head_help: The page reports its pinned profile and selected document. The head is observed separately for that same profile. Unpublished editor changes are not rendered.
ctxw_intro: Find the Contexts you can currently read. Readability does not imply ownership or permission to change them.
ctxw_create_help: Give this editorial Context a name. Creation does not publish a catalogue or website or change a Realm or Space.
ctxw_label_help: Enter a name in the selected data language. Settings and defaults use the native creation defaults.
ctxw_actions_unavailable: Current action permissions are unavailable. Changes are disabled.
ctxw_empty_help: This page reflects the current server response. Try another search or check again.
ctxw_empty_page_help: This page returned no readable Contexts. Continue to the next page to check for more.
ctxw_empty_final_page: No Contexts on this final page
ctxw_empty_final_page_help: There are no further pages. Start again to read current results with the same search and filter.

ctxw_denied: Your current permissions do not allow this request.
ctxw_missing: This Context is not currently available to you.
ctxw_invalid: Check the Context name and language before trying again.

ctxw_stale: This page cursor is no longer valid. Start again to read current results.
ctxw_unknown: The outcome is unknown. Keep this request unchanged and retry it with the same key, or read the current state.
ctxw_unavailable: Current Context information is unavailable. Check again.
ctxw_confirmed: The request was confirmed. Check the current reading below.
ctxw_global_help: Global is shared editorial authority. It cannot be deleted or restored here.
ctxw_deleted_help: This deleted Context is unavailable as an editorial source. Only metadata returned by the server is shown.
ctxw_restore_help: Contexts normally have a 30-day restoration period. The server deadline, current permissions and retention checks decide whether restoration succeeds.
ctxw_settings_help: Settings and default behavior are read-only here.
ctxw_subjects: Edit a subject in this Context
ctxw_subjects_help: Choose a subject to open its existing Context review. Reading this Context does not grant acceptance or adoption rights.
ctxw_lifecycle_unavailable: Current lifecycle metadata is unavailable. Restoration is unavailable until that metadata can be read.
ctxw_delete_help: Deletion makes this Context unavailable as an editorial source. A normally eligible Context can be restored within 30 days; current server retention and permission checks still apply.
ctxw_no_action: No lifecycle action is currently available for this resource.
subject_context_fallback: This selection returned the current Global reading.
access_transfer_responsibility: The recipient becomes an owner responsible for this Realm. The source ownership grant is removed in the same operation. Membership is managed separately.
access_transfer_lookup_failed: Find an active account other than the source owner and confirm its identity.
story_arc_intro: Describe a named narrative arc. A volume, release, season or page of results does not establish an arc.
story_arc_creation_help: Create the arc with its names first. Connect existing works and add cited facts afterward; those later contributions await review.
story_arc_relations_help: Use the released series, part-of, preceding and relationship fields. Preserve each target, order qualifier and citation; no membership is inferred.
story_arc_work_help: Select the actual work that carries this arc. Its Story arcs relation stores the arc target, position and first/last part evidence. Creating an arc does not create this relation.

library_my_logs_denied: Your published logs cannot be read with your current access.
library_my_logs_preparing: Your published logs are being prepared. Try again shortly.
library_my_logs_unavailable: Your published logs are unavailable. Try again.
library_my_logs_invalid_position: This saved page position is invalid. Open your newest published logs to continue.
library_my_logs_restarted: The page changed. Showing your newest published logs.
library_my_logs_no_visible: No visible published logs on this page.

curation_correction_unknown: A validation error could not be matched to an editable field. Review the profile in the editor.
curation_correction_missing: This field is no longer available in the current draft. Your later edits are preserved. Review the current page in the editor.
curation_correction_later: The error describes the retained publication. The editor shows your current draft, including later edits. Correct the field, then publish the revised draft.
curation_correction_help: Correct the selected field, then publish the revised draft.

manga_intro: Describe one manga series or an independently identified volume. Start with the existing catalogue identity, then enter only facts you can support.

manga_order_help: Choose the actual series. An ordinal is a position qualifier on that relation, never the order of rows.
manga_created: Created with native initial facts. Open its current reading.
manga_terms_help: Names and descriptions use the existing terms editor. Its native write producer may be unavailable; a title statement is not a title-map update.

manga_classification_help: Current classifications are shown here. The shared relation editor does not yet offer classification proposals.
literary_intro: Describe the literary work, then contribute evidence for each fact. Proposals await review before they can change the current reading.
literary_grain: Keep editions separate: ISBN and page counts belong to the actual edition. A work word count is an editorial assertion, not proof of complete word coverage.
literary_initial_help: Add only facts you know. Leave unentered facts absent. After creation, use the creator, series and original-text editors below the work identity.
literary_relations_help: Use an existing target and its exact relation slot. Book-series membership is contributed on each member work; no member count is inferred.
literary_terms_help: Names, descriptions and aliases use the existing multilingual terms editor. A missing native terms producer remains unavailable; a name statement is not a title-map edit.
literary_authored_help: Write original text with its own language, evidence and licence. Existing documents remain intact.
people_profile_intro: Create or correct the catalogue identity credited on works. Keep the named person or organization distinct from their account and from any pen name.
people_profile_terms: Names, descriptions and aliases use Edit names and descriptions. That native terms adapter may be unavailable; a name statement does not replace these terms.
people_profile_disclosure: Use public evidence for personal facts and relationships. Native disclosure, consent and target-owner eligibility decide whether a contribution is allowed. A citation does not grant permission or rights.
people_profile_credit_help: Create or open the catalogue identity first. Then use the work’s relation editor to choose that exact identity and enter the cited credit, role and qualifiers. Creating an identity does not add a credit.
people_profile_no_credit: This work has no admitted credit field in the current release.
people_profile_initial_help: Add only facts you are entering now. Initial facts are selected at creation; later corrections are separate proposals awaiting review. Empty values are invalid, never a request to clear a field.

screen_intro: Choose the actual film, series, season or episode. An independently identified publication belongs in the separate edition or release editor. Credits stay with the object they describe.
screen_native_help: Use the offered date precision and exact duration unit. Episode position describes the work, separate from personal viewing progress. Only released fields are offered.
screen_authored_after: After creation, add your own long description through the original text editor, with its language and licence.
